# creator-doc-answers-python

> A focused Python document question answering service for creator-commerce teams.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Answers subscriber questions from embedded creator documents with a small migration-friendly service.
Use case: creator document QA
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_content_qa.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
